Name: Kenneth's Easter Egg Hunt
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Happy Easter, farmer![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It's Spring 13 and the Egg Festival is happening today! Before you go to the hunt in town, I left a little Easter basket for you in the mail.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Nothing too crazy, just some Easter fun - lots of eggs, a plush bunny, spring seeds to plant, and some sweet treats. Enjoy it before Mayor Lewis starts the festival.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]15x White Egg, 15x Brown Egg, 3x Duck Egg, 1x Plush Bunny, 1x Lawn Flamingo, 30x Spring Seeds, 20x Strawberry Seeds, 20x Rhubarb Seeds, 5x Chocolate Cake, 5x Pink Cake, 2x Chest, 3x Golden Mystery Box, Stardrop Tea + 10k gold.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives via mail every Spring 13 (same day as Egg Festival, mail comes first so no conflict)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Yearly - comes back every year[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced, lore-friendly, not cheaty[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SDV 1.6+[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- One version, just install[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Happy Easter Egg Hunt![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Kenneth's New Year's Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Valentine's Gift[/b][/size]
